mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own vessels was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway distinguishes blood in the chambers from the separate supply needed by the thick heart muscle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pulmonary and systemic routes was clear but fairly predictable; the intermediate picture of two loops added little explanation beyond their arrangement.

surprise.text: The coronary return is shown flowing mainly through the coronary sinus to the right atrium. That anatomical connection was new to me, though the term itself was not explained.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. Adding conducting tissue made sense from its pacemaker picture, although the result showed the timing without explaining how the electrical pathway produces it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting the heart’s own supply to the larger circulation gave the construction a useful anatomical distinction, and I would be curious to see how the model develops.
